d: In this video, Firstpost explains how the 2026 US midterm results have set off a frenzy across the internet. As Democrats ride a blue wave and Republicans face the political fallout, social media users are wasting no time reacting. From Nicki Minaj memes and H-1B workers celebrating to Iranians joining in on the jokes, the internet is flooded with viral posts and political humour. Even as the election results reshape America's political landscape, the online reaction has become a spectacle of its own. Here's how the internet is turning Trump's midterm setback into a meme fest.
